review.summary: The plan references several modules, services, and data models that are not currently grounded in the system_state.json file, which requires revisions before implementation can proceed.

findings.title: Ungrounded registry_path reference
findings.evidence: The plan introduces `ia_redesign_config` with `registry_path`, but this path is not defined in the current system_state.json.
findings.requiredAction: Define and ground `registry_path` in system_state.json before proceeding.

findings.title: Unimplemented navigationRegistry.ts
findings.evidence: The plan introduces `src/config/navigationRegistry.ts`, but this file is not currently defined or grounded.
findings.requiredAction: Create and ground `navigationRegistry.ts` in the codebase before proceeding.

findings.title: Ungrounded section shells
findings.evidence: The plan introduces several new sections like 'Mission Control', 'Field Operations', etc., without grounding them in system_state.json.
findings.requiredAction: Ground all new sections in system_state.json and link them to the navigation registry before proceeding.

findings.title: Unimplemented officer action board components
findings.evidence: The plan introduces specific components like 'critical alert card', 'assignment stepper', etc., without defining their implementation.
findings.requiredAction: Define and ground the implementation of these components in the codebase before proceeding.

requiredAction: Escalate to Copilot for manual intervention beyond Dr Bob auto-fix scope.
